name: shimmer-skeleton
title: Shimmer Skeleton
description: A placeholder block with a soft light sweeping across it. Wrap real content and it keeps the exact size.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to stand in for. While loading it keeps its layout but is hidden.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the skeleton. When false the children render as they are.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the shimmer off and keeps a still placeholder.

props.name: className
props.description: Without children, size the block with classes such as h-4 w-40.
